testCase.name: Manifest Permission Missing
testCase.description: SecurityException due to missing CAMERA permission

error.message: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA

agent_response.error: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA
agent_response.rootCause: Missing android.permission.CAMERA in AndroidManifest.xml at line 5
fixGuidelines: 1. Add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" /> to manifest before <application> tag

2. Before:
```
<manifest>
    ...
</manifest>
```
After:
```
<manifest xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">
    <!-- Required for camera access -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />
    ...
</manifest>
```
3. Verify by running gradle clean build and checking if the app starts without permission errors.
4. If still issues, check if any other permissions are missing or if there's a need for runtime permission handling (e.g., CAMERA, LOCATION).
